terms.gloss: (term of contempt) creep, scarecrow; literally a ghost
evidence: Plaut. Merc. 5.4.20: etiam loquere, larva? (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: A ghost or spectre, and in Plautus a term of abuse, “hobgoblin, scarecrow” (Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: larva
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 299.
